body.x: GAEMS announced today that the GAEMS G155, the world’s first personal gaming and entertainment environment.

The GAEMS G155 self-contained personal gaming and entertainment environment lets you stay in the action even when you're on the move. Simply strap in your gaming console, store your accessories, select your favorite games, and you're good to go. The G155's integrated LED HD display, stereo speakers, and dual headphone jacks will immerse you in your favorite game or video--wherever you are. Merely pop it open, plug it in, and you’re ready to play.

GAEMS G155 is designed to protect its contents from the elements, debris, and minor impacts with its rugged hard-shelled casing and lockable safety latches. Mounted under the hood of the G155 you will discover a crisp and responsive 15.5” LED LCD monitor ready to display your games and movies in brilliant HD.

Securing your Xbox 360, Xbox 360s or PS3 Slim could not be easier with the custom pre-fitted EVA foam base and dual strap system ensuring that your console investment is safe, protected and has ample breathing room to keep you in the game.
